name: Etherwing Moth
description: A peculiar lifeform, shimmering with sacred golden light, that drifts like a moth through the equally mysterious interstice. Legend has it that Etherwing Moths were born from the feathers of angels who fell to the mortal world after rebelling against the lord of the heavens. However, this does not explain their presence here in the domain of eternal stasis. Perhaps, in the eyes of a certain deity, they are worth preserving, so that they may continue to bear witness to the punishment of sinners.
